title: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 103
summary: Forgiveness is carried here from maajh, Fifth Mehla: toward when my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels resentful, hurt, stuck, because it keeps forgiveness inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Forgiveness steadies when when my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His.

lines.translation: God is the Breath of Life of my soul, the Support of my mind.
His devotees live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan a(n)mrit har naamaa har dhiaai dhiaai sukh paiaa jeeau ||1||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Meditating, meditating on the Lord's Name, I have found peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa dhaar jo ghar te aavai || saadhasa(n)g janam maran miTaavai ||
lines.translation: One whose heart's desires lead him from his own home to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be rid of the cycle of birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aas manorath pooran hovai bheTat gur dharasaiaa jeeau ||2||
lines.translation: His hopes and desires are fulfilled, when he gains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar kichh mit nahee jaanee ||
lines.translation: The limits of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord cannot be known.
The seekers, the Siddhas, those beings of miraculous spiritual powers, and the spiritual teachers, all meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khudhee miTee chookaa bholaavaa gur man hee meh pragaTaiaa jeeau ||3||
lines.translation: Thus, their egos are erased, and their doubts are dispelled. The Guru has enlightened their minds. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadh ma(n)gal kaliaan nidhaanaa || sookh sahaj har naam vakhaanaa ||
lines.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Treasure of bliss, joy, salvation, intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: hoi kirapaal suaamee apanaa naau naanak ghar meh aaiaa jeeau ||4||25||32||
lines.translation: When my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His Name entered the home of my mind. ||4||25||32||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: maajh, Fifth Mehla:.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside his hopes and desires are fulfilled, when he gains the Blessed Vision of the.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: when my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His.
